text:
maria: heads up — infra gpu-pool-3 shows ~25% median latency regression on seqlen=512 since last night deploy.

 dave: saw the spike on per-model dashboard. looks like kernel handoff to slow path at token 256.

 priya: did we change node types or driver versions in that deploy?

 maria: we rolled a batch of mixed-gen nodes (A10G + A100 old BIOS). here's nvidia-smi snapshot from one host:
```
# nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,compute_cap --format=csv
name, driver_version, compute_cap
NVIDIA A10G, 540.44, 8.6
```

 sam: 540 driver is recent. compute cap 8.6 should enable tensor cores & bf16 path. why falling back?

 dave: our device-probe logic sets capability flags based on (sm_major, sm_minor) + driver matrix. but there's a second check: nvml and cuda runtime sometimes disagree when vGPU/BIOS present.

 maria: profiler trace (short) from slow run:
```
[perf] model=redwood-13B seqlen=512 batch=1
kernel_choice: tvm_kv_prefetch_slow @ 42.3ms
fallback_expected: tvm_kv_tc_fast @ ~11.8ms
kv_cache_prefetch: disabled on this host (probe_mismatch)
```

 priya: looks like probe flagged TC support false -> disabled prefetch path. hypothesis: cuDeviceGetAttribute(CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY_MAJOR) returns 8 and minor 6, but tensorCore attribute read returned 0 because driver query failed due to old kernel module mismatch.

 sam: can we reproduce with a microbench at startup? i suggest adding an immediate microbench (seq128) to validate kernel latency and flip the flag accordingly.

 dave: +1. also add a secondary check reading /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/*/pci_bus_id (or cudaGetDeviceProperties()) as a tie-breaker. and tag telemetry: probe_mismatch=true for host rollbacks.

 maria: i'll open a quick PR with startup microbench + telemetry flag. PR will also add a safety gate: if microbench shows tc_fast > 2x slower than expected, force fallback but send alert.

 priya: we should also make kernel selector tolerant: if BF16 partial but TC present, keep prefetch path for seqlen>=256 but add conservative batch sizing.

 sam: filing infra ticket to roll back the mixed-gen batch until we confirm the probe changes. ping me when PR is up. :thumbsup: 

 infra-bot: deploy:rollback requested by sam — ticket #INF-4821 created.

 dave: thanks. small follow-up: add unit test that simulates nvml/cuda disagreement so we don't regress hidden heuristics.

 maria: noted. i'll include test vectors. thanks everyone.

 (priya, dave, sam reacted :eyes: )
